fail_closed_rules: Market-specific eligibility requires a destination country.
Unknown market eligibility statuses are hidden.
No provider becomes launch-eligible merely because the country gate passes.
Checkout, shipping, profit and Owner Gate remain separate.
runtime_rule: When a country is selected, evaluate exact destination eligibility; do not infer availability from region or another country.
provider_activation_rule: A provider may be understood by the country engine before it is allowed into persisted storefront discovery. EPROLO remains excluded until its provider-level gates pass.
